get.description:
Every posting, the newest first; or one of the lists: inbox, skip, not-evaluated,
shortlist, later or ignored. A list is sorted by `sort` (score or age), by default as
its own use suits: the inbox and skip list by score, the others by age.

Stored postings from the same company, compared case- and whitespace-insensitively,
the most similar title first: the possible duplicates of a posting about to be saved.

put.description:
The user's Triage of the posting, replacing any earlier one; allowed for any
posting, evaluated or not. Refused while the posting has a live Application, which
keeps it locked at Interested.

post.description:
Start applying: a new Application in Preparing, with the posting's Triage set to
Interested. Refused while the posting has a live Application. Queues an Evaluation
of a posting that has none done or under way.

Queue a new Evaluation, with the current user inputs, of every open posting not
acted on (with no Triage and no live Application); returns them. A posting whose
Evaluation is already under way is left to it.

get.description:
The live Applications by state, Preparing to No response, the latest move first
within a state; with `closed`, only the closed ones (Accepted, Rejected, Withdrawn, No
response) or only those in flight.

delete.description:
Delete an Application while it is Preparing: it is hidden everywhere but kept, and
the posting's Triage stays Interested, changeable again. Past Preparing, an
Application is closed rather than deleted.

put.description:
Move the Application to any state, from any other; each move is kept, dated, in
its history. The Cover Letter is locked outside Preparing.

get.description: The posting's notes, the first first.

The Application's notes and its posting's, together, the first first; each says
which of the two it is on.

delete.description: Delete a note, on a posting or on an Application: it is hidden everywhere but kept.

post.description: Close a posting, keeping it: a Manual Entry is closed only by the user.

get.description: Every Evaluation of the posting, the latest first, each with what it was made with.

post.description:
Queue a new Evaluation of the posting, with the current user inputs; earlier ones
are kept as history. Also the retry of one that failed. Refused while another is
under way, unless that one is stuck: it is then failed and replaced.

get.description: The posting's latest done Evaluation, or null while it has none.

The Application's Cover Letter, its latest generation request, and whether the
posting's Evaluation is current, outdated or missing for the next one.

post.description:
Queue a new draft written by the LLM from the posting, the Career Profile, the
Writing Guide, the Evaluation's flags and the instruction; poll the Cover Letter for
it. Also the retry of a failed one. Refused unless the Application is Preparing, while
there is no Career Profile, when `evaluation_case` is not the Evaluation's case now
(the user must confirm a missing or outdated one), and while another request is under
way, unless that one is stuck.

Queue a revision in words of the latest draft, hand edits included: the LLM gets its
text and the instruction with the same inputs as generating, and its answer is a new
draft. Refused as generating is, and while there is no draft to revise.

Save the user's hand edit as the new latest draft; the earlier drafts are kept.
Refused unless the Application is Preparing.

Make an earlier draft the letter again: a new latest draft copies its text and its
record. Refused unless the Application is Preparing.

delete.description:
Delete a draft: it is hidden but kept, and the latest draft left is the letter.
Refused unless the Application is Preparing.

post.description:
Store the pasted text as a Clipping and queue its extraction; poll it for the
result.
Queue the extraction of a failed Clipping again, or of one stuck being read.
Save a done Clipping as a Manual Entry, with the user's corrections.

Give up on a done or failed Clipping, for instance for a similar posting already
stored; nothing is saved as a Job Posting.

get.description: The current version of a document, or null while the user has not written it.
The current set of Deal Breakers, or null while the user has added none.

post.description: Add a Deal Breaker; returns the new version of the set.

put.description: Change a Deal Breaker's text, keeping its id; returns the new version of the set.

delete.description: Delete a Deal Breaker; returns the new version of the set, without it.

get.description:
Whether the owner has set up a Provider; until they have, the app shows only the
setup screen.
Every Provider, whether it can be set up yet, and the owner's key for it, masked.

put.description:
Save the owner's key for the Provider, replacing any earlier one; it takes effect on
the next LLM call. Checked first by listing the Provider's models with it: a refused
key is not saved, and the Provider's reason is returned. Refused for a Provider that
is not available yet.

delete.description:
Remove the owner's key for the Provider. Removing the last one returns the app to
the setup screen.

ApplicationBriefRead.title: ApplicationBriefRead
ApplicationBriefRead.description: What a posting shows of its live Application.

ClippingConfirm.title: ClippingConfirm
ClippingConfirm.description: The envelope of the Manual Entry, as the user corrected it on the confirmation screen.

CoverLetterEvaluationRead.title: CoverLetterEvaluationRead
CoverLetterEvaluationRead.description:
Which Evaluation's flags a draft generated now would use: the current one, an
outdated one as it is, or none (missing). Ask the user to confirm the last two.

CoverLetterGenerate.title: CoverLetterGenerate
CoverLetterGenerate.description:
A request for a new draft. `evaluation_case` is the case of the posting's Evaluation
the user was told of and agreed to; a request naming another case is refused.

CoverLetterRevise.title: CoverLetterRevise
CoverLetterRevise.description:
A request to revise the latest draft, hand edits included, as `instruction` says,
from the same inputs as generating; `evaluation_case` as for generating.

EvaluationBriefRead.title: EvaluationBriefRead
EvaluationBriefRead.description: What a list row shows of a posting's current (latest done) Evaluation.

NoteRead.title: NoteRead
NoteRead.description: A note, on a posting or on an Application: exactly one of the two ids is set.

PostingCopyRead.title: PostingCopyRead
PostingCopyRead.description: The posting as it was when the Application first moved to Applied.

ProviderKeyRead.title: ProviderKeyRead
ProviderKeyRead.description: A stored key, never in full.

ProviderRead.title: ProviderRead
ProviderRead.description: A Provider: whether it can be set up yet (it has an adapter), and the owner's key.

SentCoverLetterRead.title: SentCoverLetterRead
SentCoverLetterRead.description: The Cover Letter sent on the latest move to Applied.

SetupRead.title: SetupRead
SetupRead.description: Whether the app is set up: until it is, the UI shows only the setup screen.
